title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00055 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Cleaned and cleared rig floor
00:15 - 00:30: Changed BX inserts to 5in and prepared RTTS BHA components to p/u
00:30 - 01:45: M/u RTTS BHA and RIH with 2x stands of 8,25 DC to 74m
01:45 - 02:00: RIH w/ 2x stands of DP from 74m to 147m
02:00 - 02:15: M/u TDS and set RTTS packer at 147m
02:15 - 02:45: Filled riser w/ 7. 3m3. Observed level dropped in riser 1 meter before stabilizing. Lined up TT pump and observed well static
02:45 - 03:00: Performed line test and closed BOP prior to pressure test above RTTS. Pressured up well to 6 bar and observe pressure bleeding off. Stop cement pump pressure dropped to zero
03:00 - 03:30: Opened BOP and monitored well on TT. TT level drop over 20 min before stabilizing
03:30 - 04:00: Attempted to pressure test again. Good low pressure test at 20bar/5min. Continued to pressured up to 25 bar and observed pressure bleeding off. Stopped cement pump and pressure dropped to zero
04:00 - 04:30: Opened BOP and monitored well on TT. Observed loss rate 4. 8m3/hr. Released RTTS packer, loss rate increased to 10. 8m3/hr
04:30 - 05:00: Picked up w/ RTTS packer to 142. 5m depth above top shot of 10 3/4in CSG perforation) set RTTS at 142,5m. Well static. Pressure tested above RTTS to 20bar/5min and 50bar/5min. Good test. Released RTTS. Loss rate 10m3/hr
05:00 - 05:45: M/u new stand. RIH and RTTS packer at 155m. depth below bottom shot of 10 3/4in CSG perforation) loss rate 10m3/hr. Stopped TT pump and let level drop
05:45 - 06:15: Filled pipe, performed line test. Attempted to pressure test below RTTS. No success. Pumped 1 m3, not able to achieve pressure build up
06:15 - 06:30: Released RTTS
06:30 - 07:30: POOH on DP from 155m to 8m
07:30 - 07:45: Changed inserts in elevator
07:45 - 08:00: L/d RTTS BHA
08:00 - 08:15: Cleaned and cleared rig floor
08:15 - 11:30: Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation. Agreed way forward to attempt to cure losses w/ LCM pill meanwhile serviced drilling equ

sections.text: Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Changed BX inserts to 5in and prepared RTTS BHA components to p/u
M/u RTTS BHA and RIH with 2x stands of 8,25 DC to 74m
RIH w/ 2x stands of DP from 74m to 147m
M/u TDS and set RTTS packer at 147m
Filled riser w/ 7. 3m3. Observed level dropped in riser 1 meter before stabilizing. Lined up TT pump and observed well static
Performed line test and closed BOP prior to pressure test above RTTS. Pressured up well to 6 bar and observe pressure bleeding off. Stop cement pump pressure dropped to zero
Opened BOP and monitored well on TT. TT level drop over 20 min before stabilizing
Attempted to pressure test again. Good low pressure test at 20bar/5min. Continued to pressured up to 25 bar and observed pressure bleeding off. Stopped cement pump and pressure dropped to zero
Opened BOP and monitored well on TT. Observed loss rate 4. 8m3/hr. Released RTTS packer, loss rate increased to 10. 8m3/hr

Picked up w/ RTTS packer to 142. 5m depth above top shot of 10 3/4in CSG perforation) set RTTS at 142,5m. Well static. Pressure tested above RTTS to 20bar/5min and 50bar/5min. Good test. Released RTTS. Loss rate 10m3/hr
M/u new stand. RIH and RTTS packer at 155m. depth below bottom shot of 10 3/4in CSG perforation) loss rate 10m3/hr. Stopped TT pump and let level drop
Filled pipe, performed line test. Attempted to pressure test below RTTS. No success. Pumped 1 m3, not able to achieve pressure build up
Released RTTS
POOH on DP from 155m to 8m
Changed inserts in elevator
L/d RTTS BHA
Cleaned and cleared rig floor

Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation. Agreed way forward to attempt to cure losses w/ LCM pill meanwhile serviced drilling equipment. Housekeeping. Adjusted link tilt, performed maintenance on ps21, TDS, greased both prss.
Filled the well w/ sea water, observed returns at surface after 8,7 m3 pumped. Prepared and start mixing 400kg/m3 LCM pill in pump room
Continued mixing 400kg/m3 LCM pill in pump room. Hopper is packing off while mixing. Continued to mix manually. Worked good flow checked on TT. Loss rate 10m3/hr
Continued mixing 400kg/m3 LCM pill in pump room changed handling equipment and prepared to RIH w/ drill pipe
Continued mixing 400kg/m3 LCM pill in pump room RIH w/ 5,5in DP from surface to 845m
Continued mixing LCM pill while monitoring well. Loss rate 11m3/hrs. Meanwhile isolated and removed suction strainers in MP#2

Pumped 15m3 1. 3sg 400kg/m3 LCM pill 550 LPM. When pill starts to exit string, decreased pump rate to 160l/min. Lined up TT and kept volume in TT static by adjusting pump rate between 160-200l/min to avoid LCM going up annulus and avoid SW from annulus dropping down and mix with LCM. Pumped and pulled to top of stand when 2 m3 LCM left in the DP string. Stopped pumping after all LCM volume out of the DP string. Loss rate during pumping and displacing LCM pill 11m3/hr
Stop pumping and monitor well on TT for 30 min. Loss rate 10 m3/hr
POOH w/ 5,5in DP from 900m to surface. Average pulling speed 1200 m/hour
Removed ps21, installed master bushing
Performed pre-job meeting to RIH w/ RTTS
M/u RTTS BHA from surface to 88m
